self_assessment.weakest_area: OG image params (skillCount, collectionCount) read 0 on SSR for non-bot user agents because the page uses lazy useFetch. Same pattern as /people/[handle], so consistent with existing pages, but worth verifying social shares look right when the page is first loaded.
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Avatar shape (rounded-full vs rounded-lg) was the only kind-specific differentiation that survived contact with the 'quiet' brand. Considered larger headline scaling, kind-specific layouts, and color tints; all violated the 90/10 neutrals/accent budget. The shape + four characters of mono badge text is the entire visual story for kind, which is in line with the principle that quiet character comes from precision, not volume.

known_limitations: OG image renders with skillCount=0/collectionCount=0 on non-bot SSR (same as /people/[handle]).
First request per owner is cold (~500-1500ms) due to GitHub API. Subsequent requests served from KV cache.
next_steps: Optional: add an /orgs/ index page listing top owners.
